mapper.select: SELECT sv.voucher_id,a.has_published FROM tb_seckill_voucher sv LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_activity a ON a.voucher_id=sv.voucher_id
SELECT sv.*,v.status+0 AS status FROM tb_seckill_voucher sv JOIN tb_voucher v ON v.id=sv.voucher_id WHERE sv.voucher_id=#{voucherId}
SELECT a.total_stock,s.stock FROM tb_seckill_activity a JOIN tb_seckill_voucher s USING(voucher_id) WHERE voucher_id=#{voucherId}
